channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula abre giro europeu com Sánchez na Espanha para ampliar agenda bilateral e 'defender democracia'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is attending the 1st Brazil-Spain Summit in Barcelona, co-chaired by Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, focusing on economy, science, technology, culture, and gender equality. The meeting aims to strengthen bilateral ties and defend democracy.

item.title: Lula vai usar saúde como trunfo contra Flávio Bolsonaro, mas estratégia tem riscos
item.description: Lula and his government plan to use health as a central theme in the 2026 re-election campaign, contrasting his administration with Jair Bolsonaro’s during the pandemic, emphasizing improved vaccination rates, access to specialists, and national production of medicines. The strategy aims to link Flávio Bolsonaro to a potential rollback in health policies and the threat of Brazil withdrawing from international organizations like WHO and PAHO, leveraging fear of a Bolsonarist return to power.

item.title: Lula é recebido por Pedro Sánchez em cerimônia oficial, na Espanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was received by Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez in an official ceremony in Barcelona, marking the opening of the 1st Spain-Brazil Summit. The meeting reinforced the bilateral agenda with a focus on political and economic cooperation, including support for the Mercosul-European Union agreement. Lula will remain in Spain until Saturday, when he will participate in a forum on defending democracy against extremism.

item.title: Como o governo está simplificando o processo de emissão de documentos em 2026
item.description: The Brazilian government is simplifying document issuance in 2026 through integrated digital platforms, unified digital identity, and more accessible service channels. The reform goes beyond mere digitization, emphasizing system interoperability and reducing bureaucratic hurdles for citizens.

item.title: Detido nos EUA, Ramagem vê em xeque um sonho que embalou os bolsonaristas: o exílio seguro
item.description: Alexandre Ramagem, former head of Brazil's intelligence agency (Abin) and convicted to 16 years in prison by the STF for his role in the 2022-2023 coup plot, was arrested in Florida by ICE after overstaying a tourist visa. He is awaiting a U.S. decision on his asylum request and Brazil’s extradition demand, while his allies deny the arrest is politically motivated, claiming it was merely a traffic violation. His detention reveals the false belief among Bolsonarist fugitives that they would be safe in right-wing governed countries.

item.title: Governo Lula lança guia que ensina “linguagem não sexista”
item.description: The Lula government launched the Public Communication Guide for Gender Equality, produced by the Ministry of Women, advocating for non-sexist language in public administration to combat inequality and patriarchy. The 54-page document, part of the Brazil Pact against Femicide, argues that all state communication is inherently political and neutrality is impossible. It provides examples such as replacing 'citizens' with 'population' and using 'good morning to everyone and all'.

item.title: Nunes Marques poupa governador de RR com base em informação errada
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques voted to keep Roraima Governor Edilson Damião in office based on false information, claiming he was not part of the government between 2021 and 2022, despite records showing he served as State Secretary of Infrastructure during that period. The trial over the 2022 elected ticket’s cassation for political and economic abuse of power was suspended after a view request by Minister Estela Aranha. Rapporteur Minister Isabel Gallotti had voted for annulment, citing illegal social programs launched during the election year without prior budgetary execution.

item.title: Dez anos do impeachment de Dilma: por onde andam principais envolvidos
item.description: Ten years after the impeachment of Dilma Rousseff, many of the key figures involved remain active in Brazilian politics. Michel Temer, her vice president who succeeded her, is sidelined from electoral races due to Lava Jato convictions, while authors of the impeachment request like Hélio Bicudo and Janaína Paschoal continue their influence in the judiciary and Congress. The polarization sparked by that process continues to shape the 2026 electoral landscape, with Lula and Bolsonaro as central poles.

item.title: Entenda os fatores que levaram ao avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre Lula nas pesquisas
item.description: Recent polls show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) slightly ahead of Lula (PT) in the 2026 presidential runoff, within the margin of error, due to the transfer of political capital from Jair Bolsonaro, voter fatigue with the current administration, and negative economic perceptions. Despite challenges like low name recognition, Flavio has unified the right-wing electorate and gained ground among independents.

item.title: Lula vai a reunião da esquerda mundial em meio a tensões globais com Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) travels to Barcelona to attend the Global Progressive Mobilisation, a gathering of global left-wing leaders amid rising tensions with Donald Trump. The itinerary includes stops in Germany and Portugal, focusing on threats to democracy, disinformation, and gender-based violence. Analysts view the Spain leg as a political minefield due to Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s sharp criticism of U.S. actions and Trump.

item.title: Cadê o ‘Posto Ipiranga’ de Flávio?
item.description: The text questions the delay in announcing Flávio Bolsonaro's promised 'Posto Ipiranga' initiative, comparing it to Paulo Guedes' vague 'next week' rhetoric during his tenure when proposals were stalled by the Centrão. The analogy suggests Flávio seeks someone who could bring him the same credibility Guedes gave to Jair Bolsonaro, but such a figure has not yet emerged. The content is framed as exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Promessa de freio nos gastos em 2027 não convence mercado em meio a ceticismo sobre contas públicas
item.description: The government proposes a strong fiscal adjustment for 2027, limiting total spending growth to just 1% above inflation, after years of averaging 5% above inflation. This reduction relies on factors such as declining judicial rulings, stabilization of the Fundeb, and tight control of personnel spending, which is projected to rise by only R$ 2 billion nominally. Despite government optimism, financial markets remain skeptical, viewing the projections as overly optimistic and warning that the fiscal deficit could be larger than stated.

item.title: Soma das dívidas dos ‘enrolados’ no alvo do novo programa de renegociação pode chegar a R$ 140 bi
item.description: The new debt renegotiation program by the Lula government could cover up to R$ 140 billion in credit card, overdraft, and unsecured personal loans, with delays ranging from 91 days to three years, held by individuals earning up to five minimum wages. The estimate is based on December 2025 data and aims to bring 'delinquent' borrowers back into the financial system. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Governistas articulam jantar entre Lula, Alcolumbre e senadores para destravar apoio a Messias antes de sabatina
item.description: Government allies are organizing a dinner between President Lula, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and senators to secure support for Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) ahead of his hearing on April 28. The meeting aims to overcome resistance from undecided senators amid a tight calendar, as the Tiradentes holiday will empty Brasília and limit in-person negotiations. Despite progress in talks, many senators remain unwilling to declare their vote publicly, leaving the outcome uncertain as the hearing approaches.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Alguns se tornaram experts em afastar pessoas', diz Nikolas Ferreira após ataques de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Nikola Ferreira describes his role as an ‘attacker’ whose job is to convey ideas, not just names, in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre‑campaign. He criticizes Eduardo Bolsonaro’s one‑sided attacks and warns that supporters who act as ‘experts at pushing people away’ hinder outreach.

item.title: Lula visita Portugal em momento crucial para cidadania de milhares brasileiros
item.description: President Lula will visit Portugal at a critical moment, as the Portuguese government has approved rules increasing the residency requirement for Brazilian citizenship from five to seven years, affecting thousands who were close to qualifying. The Brazilian community in Portugal, estimated at 700,000, fears the change is retroactive and unfair, and Lula will pressure Portuguese President António José Seguro and Prime Minister Luís Montenegro to reverse or veto the measure, invoking the CPLP agreement and equal rights.

item.title: Na fase mais artilheira da carreira, Danilo brilha no Botafogo e fica perto de vaga na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Danilo, Botafogo's midfielder, is experiencing his most prolific goal-scoring phase in his career with eight goals and two assists in 17 matches in 2026, putting him close to a World Cup 2026 call-up. His improved form began after coach Martín Anselmi tactically moved him closer to attack, reversing earlier underperformance as a deep-lying midfielder. Despite European interest, including a Zenit offer worth up to €25 million, Danilo remains focused on earning a return to the Brazil national team.

item.title: Pré-candidatos à Presidência da República elaboram estratégias para atrair eleitor; veja quais
item.description: Presidential pre-candidates for 2026 are shaping their communication strategies based on electoral polls. Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aim to reduce rejection by leveraging anti-PT and anti-Bolsonaro sentiments, while Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo) seek to increase national name recognition. The PT’s campaign emphasizes household debt and attempts to link rising fuel prices to the war initiated by Donald Trump in Iran, associating it with the Bolsonaro family’s support for the former U.S. president.

item.title: Río de Janeiro, sin nadie al volante: la enésima crisis política deja al Estado sin gobernador
item.description: Rio de Janeiro state is facing an aggravated political crisis due to the absence of an elected governor, following the resignation or removal of the last officeholder, leaving the state executive without legitimate leadership. The situation, described as a recurring theme in local media, reflects years of institutional instability, with Christ the Redeemer symbolically portrayed as overwhelmed or desperate amid the governmental collapse. With 17 million inhabitants and Brazil’s second-largest economy, the state is experiencing a power vacuum that threatens governability and essential services.

item.title: Las fuerzas progresistas buscan nuevo impulso global en Barcelona
item.description: Progressive forces from dozens of countries are gathering in Barcelona to revitalize the social democratic agenda amid rising nationalism and far-right movements. The conference aims to foster unity among fragmented currents and renew political enthusiasm. It runs parallel to a democracy defense summit and the first Spain-Brazil bilateral summit, featuring Pedro Sánchez and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as key leaders.

item.title: Sánchez y Lula consolidan su vínculo como líderes de la izquierda en Europa y América
item.description: Pedro Sánchez and Lula da Silva, as leaders of the left in Europe and Latin America, will meet in Barcelona to position themselves as a global alternative to the rise of right-wing and far-right movements led by figures like Donald Trump. Their meeting aims to strengthen political coordination between progressive forces in Europe and Latin America amid increasing global polarization.

item.title: El ejemplo de Lula
item.description: At 80 years old and with 11 years as president of Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva warns that the world is like a ship adrift, without institutions to guide the civilizatory conduct of nations. He expresses astonishment at the current global geopolitical situation, emphasizing the lack of international direction.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: presidente da Câmara discute hoje com ministro de Lula saída para sobreposição de propostas
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta and Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães meet to discuss ending the 6x1 work schedule, with disagreements over whether the proposal should advance as a constitutional amendment (PEC) or a bill. Governors and mayors owe nearly R$ 730 billion to the Union, and the government forecasts R$ 10 billion in off-budget state-owned enterprise spending in 2027. The executive bill seeks to reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours without pay cuts, benefiting 14 million workers currently on the 6x1 schedule.

item.title: Lula faz giro pela Europa; viagem começa pela Espanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva begins his European tour this Friday (17) in Spain, attending the 1st Brazil–Spain Summit and meetings with business leaders, followed by a visit to Germany on April 19–20, where he will meet Chancellor Friedrich Merz and sign agreements on defense, AI, and infrastructure. The trip also includes participation in the Democracy Always Forum in Barcelona, aiming to strengthen democratic and commercial ties, with Spain being Brazil’s eighth-largest trading partner in 2024. Lula is expected to return to Brazil on Wednesday (22).

item.title: Ustra, cusparada, gângster e Tiririca: relembre 10 marcos da sessão do impeachment de Dilma
item.description: On April 17, 2016, the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies held the vote that opened the impeachment process against President Dilma Rousseff, with House President Eduardo Cunha repeatedly asking "How do you vote, deputy?" hundreds of times. The plenary was packed, and the session became infamous for moments such as Jair Bolsonaro’s "cusp" in tribute to Colonel Ustra, along with other incidents involving figures like Tiririca. The event was a symbolic and political milestone in the institutional crisis that led to Rousseff’s removal.

item.title: Roberto Kalil é eleito titular da Academia Nacional de Medicina
item.description: Cardiologist Roberto Kalil, personal physician to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, was elected as a full member of the National Academy of Medicine on April 16, 2026, receiving 72 out of 96 votes in a secret ballot. He will occupy Chair No. 1, patronized by Joaquim Cândido Soares de Meirelles, and contribute to strategic discussions shaping Brazil’s public health policies.

item.title: Câmara aprova regime mais rígido para condenados por assassinato de policiais
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill establishing a differentiated disciplinary regime for those convicted of killing or attempting to kill police officers or military personnel while on duty. The regime includes solitary confinement, restricted visits, mail monitoring, reduced cell exits, and a maximum duration of two years, and may extend to relatives of military personnel and pretrial detainees. The bill now awaits sanction by President Lula.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump “não foi eleito imperador do mundo”
item.description: Lula criticized Donald Trump, stating he "was not elected emperor of the world" and cannot continually threaten other countries with war, particularly regarding potential actions against Iran, Venezuela, and Cuba. He urged the UN Secretary-General to convene an extraordinary General Assembly to restore global order, while affirming that the U.S. remains an important trade partner for Brazil. Regarding the 2026 elections, Lula said he would accept the electoral outcome even if Flávio Bolsonaro wins, and rejected the global rise of what he described as a right-wing ideology spreading hatred and lies.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que direciona 5% das multas de trânsito ao Fundo Nacional de Segurança
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill allocating 5% of traffic fine revenues collected by states, the Federal District, and municipalities to the National Public Security Fund. Funds may be used for infrastructure, equipment, vehicles, and training of traffic agents, provided the jurisdiction proves it maintains a structured traffic safety agency with a formal career path. The proposal now awaits sanction by President Lula.

item.title: O próximo passo no STF para manter a prisão de ex-presidente do BRB
item.description: The Second Chamber of the Brazilian Federal Supreme Court (STF) will decide between April 22 and 24 whether to uphold or overturn the arrest of former BRB president Paulo Henrique Costa, ordered by Justice André Mendonça. The arrest took place last Thursday as part of Operation Compliance Zero, investigating financial fraud tied to Banco Master and alleged luxury real estate bribes. The virtual ruling will require a majority vote from the five justices: Mendonça, Gilmar Mendes, Luiz Fux, Dias Toffoli, and Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Tarcísio de Freitas diz que Flávio Bolsonaro pode vencer Lula no primeiro turno
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) could defeat Lula in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, citing polls showing the senator narrowly leading in a potential runoff and expressing confidence in his victory. He also criticized the STF’s investigation into Flávio for alleged defamation, arguing that political criticism should not be subject to sanctions and defending freedom of expression.

item.title: Tarcísio explica foto com funkeiro preso em operação da PF
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas responded to controversy over a photo with a funk singer arrested in a PF operation, stating he does not check criminal records before taking photos or attending events. He defended the approach as part of his routine of engaging with society without prior judgments.

item.title: Lula sobre eventual vitória de Flávio: ‘Seja de direita ou esquerda, temos que aceitar resultado’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated he will accept the outcome of the 2026 presidential election, even if won by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), emphasizing respect for the popular will regardless of ideology. While avoiding explicit confirmation of his candidacy, Lula said he is preparing for a fourth term and believes he will win, arguing that 'there is no room for fascists' among Brazilians.

item.title: ICE diz à PF que Ramagem pode aguardar conclusão do processo de asilo nos EUA em liberdade
item.description: Alexandre Ramagem was released from U.S. custody after applying for political asylum, according to ICE’s communication to the PF. His release occurred prior to a previously scheduled meeting between Brazilian and U.S. authorities aimed at discussing his case and preventing his release. The Brazilian government had hoped to keep him detained during deportation negotiations but now awaits updates on his immigration status.

item.title: Com saída de Odair ao TCU, PT irá à Justiça para manter vaga na Câmara
item.description: The PT is seeking judicial intervention to ensure that Gilmar Machado (PT), the second substitute of the Brazil of Hope federation, assumes the seat vacated by Odair Cunha in the Chamber of Deputies following his appointment to the TCU. The first substitute, Glaycon Franco, left the PV for the PSDB during the party window, which the PT argues disqualifies him from inheriting the mandate, maintaining that the seat belongs to the party, not the individual. The TSE and electoral precedents support this position, as the federation remained intact and the second substitute remained affiliated with the PT.

item.title: Representantes de Lula e Trump discutem investigação comercial dos EUA que inclui o Pix
item.description: Representatives from the Lula administration and the Trump government met in Washington to discuss the U.S. Section 301 trade investigation targeting Brazilian policies such as Pix and ethanol. Brazil provided technical clarifications without expecting immediate decisions and reiterated it will not alter Pix under external pressure. The government emphasized consensus-building, despite the recent passage of the Economic Reciprocity Law by Congress.

item.title: Tarcísio se manifesta sobre foto com funkeiro preso em operação da PF
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas commented on a photo showing him alongside Rodrigo Inácio de Lima Oliveira, founder of GR6 Explode, who was arrested in Operation Narco Fluxo on suspicion of money laundering linked to drug trafficking. Tarcísio stated he does not check criminal records when taking photos at events and emphasized the meeting was personal, not official, held in August 2024 at singer Latino’s residence, not on his official schedule.

item.title: Haddad estreia apelido para Flávio: 'o bolsonarinho'
item.description: Fernando Haddad responded to a post by Flávio Bolsonaro, who used images of people in vulnerable conditions — including children — from 2021, during the Bolsonaro government, falsely attributing them to Lula’s administration. Haddad posted a video on social media rebutting the misinformation and nicknamed Flávio 'the little Bolsonaro'.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump "não pode ficar ameaçando outros países com guerra o tempo todo"
item.description: President Lula criticized Donald Trump for constantly threatening other countries with war, stating he was not elected 'emperor of the world'. Lula said he had appealed to leaders like Xi Jinping, Putin, and Macron to convene a UN Security Council meeting on the Iran conflict, but received no response. He urged immediate reform of the UN Security Council to include permanent members from Africa, the Middle East, Brazil, and Germany, arguing that the current permanent members — the world’s largest arms producers and nuclear powers — undermine global peace.

item.title: Moçambicanos se inspiram no sistema de votação brasileiro e elogiam urna eletrônica
item.description: A delegation of five technicians from Mozambique's Constitutional Council visited Brazil's TSE to study the electronic voting system, praising its security, reliability and efficiency. They expressed interest in adopting the model in their country, emphasizing the need to strengthen democracy through advanced electoral technology. The visit was part of the Tobias Barreto exchange program, focused on digitalization and institutional strengthening between the two nations.

item.title: Em carta, Edegar Pretto diz que será vice de Juliana Brizola no RS
item.description: Edegar Pretto (PT) announced he will be the vice-gubernatorial candidate on Juliana Brizola's (PDT) ticket for the Rio Grande do Sul state government in 2026, following guidance from the state PT leadership, discussions with local figures, and a request from President Lula. He affirmed his commitment to progressive values and aims to strengthen Lula's political base in the state, marking the first time the PT will not field its own candidate for the Piratini Palace.

item.title: Por mais tempo para articular, governo avalia adiar sabatina de Messias
item.description: The Lula government is considering postponing Jorge Messias' STF confirmation hearing from Tuesday (April 28) to Wednesday (April 29) to gain more time for political negotiations with senators, aiming to avoid senator fatigue and potential lack of quorum in a same-day CCJ and plenary vote. The decision hinges on balancing attendance assurance with extended negotiation time, as approval remains uncertain with an expected tight vote.

item.title: Após ser solto, Ramagem diz que PF de Andrei Rodrigues é de “jagunços”
item.description: Former federal deputy Alexandre Ramagem (PL-RJ) was released after 48 hours in ICE custody in the U.S., following detention during a routine traffic stop. He accused the Brazilian Federal Police and its director-general, Andrei Rodrigues, of becoming a 'police of gunmen,' claiming his detention was unjust and that his U.S. status is fully regular. Ramagem thanked allies including Allan dos Santos, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Paulo Figueiredo, and Senator Hiran Gonçalves, and claimed that Trump administration officials intervened to secure his administrative release without bond or judicial proceedings.

item.title: Dallagnol ocupa 2º lugar nas pesquisas, mas está inelegível
item.description: Former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol ranks second in Paraná Senate race polls with 28.2% voting intention, but remains ineligible until 2030 due to a TSE decision that annulled his candidacy in 2023. The Paraná Pesquisas survey, conducted April 10-12, 2026 with 1,500 respondents, shows ex-senator Alvaro Dias (MDB) leading with 44.5%. Dallagnol's ineligibility stems from the TSE's finding that his resignation as prosecutor was timed to avoid Ficha Clean Law sanctions.

item.title: SP deposita R$ 561 milhões para desapropriações do túnel Santos-Guarujá e cobra governo federal
item.description: The São Paulo government deposited R$ 561.89 million with Mota-Engil to fund expropriations and resettlements for the Santos-Guarujá tunnel project, as announced by the Tarcísio administration. The state also demanded the federal government fulfill its promised financial contributions to the infrastructure project linking the ports of Santos and Guarujá.

item.title: “Não pode ficar ameaçando outros países o tempo todo”, diz Lula sobre Trump
item.description: President Lula criticized Donald Trump for constantly threatening other countries with war, stating that Trump was not elected 'emperor of the world' and that such threats are unacceptable. He stressed the need for a world grounded in dialogue and mutual respect between nations.

item.title: Oposição perde ‘bala de prata’ e candidato do PL corre sozinho na eleição da Alerj
item.description: Judge Suely Lopes Magalhães denied the opposition's request for a secret ballot in the Alerj presidential election, preserving an open vote that favors Douglas Ruas (PL). The ruling shattered the opposition's last hope to block Ruas's ascent, as secret voting was seen as key to building an alternative candidacy free from party pressure. The court ruled that voting procedure is an internal legislative matter, not subject to judicial intervention, particularly after the STF clarified that the Alerj president does not automatically succeed the governor in case of vacancy.

item.title: USP teve ao menos 680 dias de paralisações em 3 décadas
item.description: Since 1995, the University of São Paulo (USP) has experienced at least 680 days of strikes, primarily over salaries, hiring, and working conditions. The latest strike began on April 14, 2026, by technical and administrative staff, later joined by students who added demands regarding student housing, university restaurants, and space management. The approval of GACE, a bonus for professors in March, has divided faculty and been criticized by unions for threatening salary equity.

item.title: Kalil eleito para a Academia Nacional de Medicina
item.description: Roberto Kalil, physician to Lula, president of the InCor Board at Hospital das Clínicas and general director of the Cardiology Center at Hospital Sírio-Libanês, has been elected to the National Academy of Medicine with 72 out of 96 possible votes. The achievement reflects his recognized expertise in cardiology and hospital management in Brazil.

item.title: O alerta dado pelo líder do PL no Senado a Jorge Messias, indicado por Lula ao STF
item.description: PL Senate leader Carlos Portinho met with Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the STF, and reaffirmed his opposition to the appointment, stating he will not vote in favor. Portinho warned Messias about the unfavorable political climate, citing tensions between Congress and the STF due to the Organized Crime CPI, which voted to indict ministers of the Court, triggering defensiveness and corporatism among senators. The PL, with 32 senators, has closed ranks against the nomination, leaving Messias to seek the required votes solely from the government base.
